name: path
meaning: Scn_GetPropTrajectory(IDWATERTRAJ) (0x4c2a12): the course from the water to the crane; the last point is where the crane is called

name: crane
meaning: the level's Crane (Scenaric_FindByClass(0x52) 0x4c2b4f); none disables the river (0x4c2b66). Sent msg 0x37 with the cargo at the last point (0x4c3b24)

name: nodeDist
meaning: Vec3s_DistXZ from the moved cargo to its node, written by every FrozenRiver_MoveCargo (0x4c396c); compared unsigned with 50 (0x4c3983), divided signed (0x4c3b44)

name: floeTimer
meaning: ms since the last floe launch (+= g_dtMs 0x4c3e91); a floe launches once it passes 10000 (0x4c3c0f, unsigned)

name: waterBoxes
meaning: IDWATERBOX list (Scn_FindIdList 0x4c2c93): msg 0x36 registers a sender inside one of them (0x4c2efd, 2-D)

name: camera
meaning: Scn_GetPropCamera(CAMERA) (0x4c2b2f): started once when the Wolf reaches the last point (0x4c3a4b)

name: floeStart
meaning: where floes are put in: path point 0 (0x4c2a27) with y = top of waterBoxes[0] + 110 (0x4c2ce2), or 110 without boxes

name: floesActive
meaning: floes in the water (LaunchFloe ++ 0x4c3c6f, -- when the crane takes one 0x4c30c5); FrozenRiver_UpdateCargo walks floes[0..floesActive)

name: enabled
meaning: 1 from PostLoadInit (0x4c29f1), 0 without a Crane; Update does nothing unless it is 1 (0x4c2ea0)

name: floeOnCrane
meaning: set when the crane takes a floe (msg 0x3e 0x4c30f6), cleared by a SlidingIceCube's msg 0x36 (0x4c3638); stops floe launches and the floes' crane call

name: wolfInRiver
meaning: cargo[0] holds the Wolf (0x4c3579); cleared when the crane takes him (0x4c2ffe)

name: sheepInRiver
meaning: cargo[1] holds a Sheep (0x4c3610); cleared when the crane takes it (0x4c3014)

name: craneBusy
meaning: msg 0x3e's argument bit 0 (0x4c2f26): the crane has its hook on a cargo; no crane call while set (0x4c3aff)

name: camStarted
meaning: the river camera was started for the Wolf at the last point (0x4c3ad6); cleared by msg 0x3e (0x4c2f86)
